picks.title: Your Brain Lies to You (And That's a Good Thing): Anil Seth on Consciousness
picks.summary: What if everything you see, hear, and feel isn't real? What if it's just your brain's best prediction of what's real? Dr. Heather Berlin and Dr. Christof Koch sat down with neuroscientist and consciousness researcher Anil Seth to explore the profound question of: What is consciousness? Seth's answer might surprise (and even unsettle) you. Consciousness isn't a window onto reality. picks.reason: A neuroscientist deeply examines consciousness as brain-generated experience, not direct reality.

picks.title: Diana Pasulka: The Others, UFOs, AI, Death & the Vatican
picks.summary: Dr Diana Pasulka returns to discuss her new book, *The Others*, in a wide-ranging two-hour conversation exploring UFOs, AI, religion, death, consciousness and Disclosure.We get into who or what “The Others” may be, whether UFO belief is becoming a new religion, the links between anomalous experiences and the afterlife, Peter Thiel and the Antichrist, the Vatican archives, misinformation in ufology and how Diana’s own views have changed over the years.Plus: crash retrievals, recovered bodies, NHI deception and what may come next.Get your copy here - https://amzn.eu/d/0967LUcq🔥 Support the show

picks.title: Condition of the Heart - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E5
picks.summary:
What happens when we look like we’re following God on the outside, but our hearts are far from Him?
In Matthew 23, Jesus confronts the Pharisees for their hypocrisy, legalism and self righteousness, exposing the danger of doing all the right religious things without truly loving God. 
Following Jesus isn’t about how well we look, how closely we follow the rules or how much we do for Him. More than anything, God wants our hearts, and everything else should flow from our love for Him.

Matthew 23:1–39

Revelation 2:1–5

picks.reason: Explores hypocrisy and true love for God beyond religious formality in a Christian context.

picks.title: Why Healing My Internal World Changed Every Relationship in My External World — The Spiritual and Personal Growth That Showed Me How to Outgrow Old Patterns and Live a Life Full of Purpose and Passion
picks.summary: What if changing your relationships starts with changing what’s happening inside you?In this deeply personal episode of WE, Joe Mittiga shares how healing old emotional wounds transformed the way he experienced love, relationships, spirituality, and himself. He explores why some relationships deepen as we grow while others must change or be released, and how healing from the inside out can lead to greater freedom, purpose, connection, and peace.This episode is an invitation to stop looking outside yourself for what may be waiting to be healed within.
picks.reason: Personal growth story linking inner healing to relationships and purpose.
